STUNNING PENTHOUSE LIVING IN THE HEART OF KITSILANO!

Experience the best of indoor-outdoor living in this exceptional A/C penthouse, featuring an impressive 843 SF private rooftop patio — the perfect setting for summer BBQs, entertaining guests, gardening, or simply soaking up the sun. A second balcony overlooking a quiet, tree-lined street offers an additional outdoor retreat.

Inside, enjoy a bright and spacious open-concept layout with 9' ceilings, complemented by a chef-inspired kitchen featuring granite countertops, elegant Scavolini cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, an integrated refrigerator, and a gas cooktop. Generously sized bedrooms, a spa-inspired bathroom, and a thoughtfully designed floor plan complete this inviting home.

Residents enjoy access to excellent building amenities, including a fitness centre, landscaped courtyard, and playground.

Ideally situated just steps from Kitsilano Beach, beautiful parks, trendy cafés, popular restaurants, boutique shopping, and convenient transit.

A rare opportunity to enjoy penthouse living with exceptional outdoor space in one of Vancouver's most sought-after neighbourhoods!
